name: XP Chemistries AB (publ)
summary: As a biotechnology company, XP Chemistries AB specializes in the development and production of forest-derived capsaicin and its related compounds. Its diverse offerings include ingredients for animal nutrition, components for cosmetic formulations, high-purity capsaicinoids, and active agents for self-defense products. Founded in 2018, the Swedish firm operates from its base in Sundsvall.
